environment: Local Cloudflare Vitest/workerd, D1 emulator and real WorkspaceEvents Durable Objects; no remote services
workload: Three user-impact capture hooks, one revision change per workspace, request-boundary fencing. Cold uses newly named coordinators; warm reuses coordinators. No document/table rooms are populated.
counts: Request-side D1 prepare/execute operations and coordinator fetches; excludes fixture setup, mutation statements and coordinator-internal D1 work. Latencies include the same mutation statements in both variants.
precision: Local performance.now resolves to integer milliseconds; p50 is sorted sample 11 and p95 is sample 19 of 20. These are local regression observations, not production network latency estimates.
